The main takeaway from our work is that
, when the agents have access to a sufficiently rich information set, a Block Recursive Equilibria exists and it is a reasonable approximation of the equilibrium of a stochastic environment.
the Block Recursive Equilibria of the stochastic model of search on the job are qualitatively similar to the equilibria of the analogous model of random search on job.
